policy: Every discovered function extent and every initialized .text byte is assigned exactly once. product_application_or_glue means evidenced Peer Pressure component behavior, integration glue, or a modified upstream-derived adapter that remains in the reconstruction queue; it is not a claim of personal authorship, originality, or exclusive copyright. Only stock-source-equivalent upstream blocks and proven platform/toolchain blocks are excluded from lifting. Code with only an XDK-facing role or cross-component sharing remains unknown.
classification_rules: A function extent is the half-open interval from its inventory entry to the next entry, with the final extent capped at the initialized .text end.

A contiguous library block requires multiple exact upstream string/semantic anchors, agreement with source organization, function-aligned link boundaries, and corroboration from the separately linked SettingsApp copy.

Product classification includes the two update-policy routines, the XHttps/update integration bodies established by component-local strings and call topology, and the BearSSL-derived C++/platform certificate adapter. UpdateCheck-peer-source-coverage.json currently covers 16 of 19 product/mixed entries (4,400 of 6,768 bytes) and keeps the remaining three orchestration entries explicit.

MSVC STL/CRT/startup code, the XEX entry stub, import thunks, and compiler-emitted string/vector/map support islands are platform/toolchain when binary diagnostics or structural evidence establish that provenance; merely calling XDK imports is insufficient.
Code without a defensible source boundary is unknown even when it is shared between Peer Pressure components.
